_about: Table 5 of 6: regional encounters (#193), worked slice: the Goblin Marches and the Queen's Hold (region 2, floors 3-4). Health, damage and threat are read from data/enemies/*.tres by the probe and scaled by the floor (combat_state DEPTH_SCALE). Armour and weaknesses are PROPOSALS (enemies have no armour in the game today; 'strike' is presentation only), so the probe reports both today's rules and the proposed ones.

strike_rules._about: Proposal: a smash ignores 1 armour; a slash does +1 to an unarmoured foe; a pierce does +1 to beasts (hounds, bloats) and reaches.

ordinary.counter: reach or Shoot; close the gap
smash, Biting; the guard wall halves damage to those behind it
kill first: it powers the others
Brace the heavy blow, strike while it recovers; kite it
hit it to free a grabbed hero; kite it
pierce, hound-breaker; corridors (they hit harder in a pack)
kill it from the back row or with a thrown torch

dangerous_combinations.why: the guard wall halves damage to the goblins behind it; the archer shoots past
the drummer lifts the brute's already-heavy blows
a pack hits harder while another stands; fast

elite.why: the optional elite: 18+ health and a heavy blow

counters: kill guards as they come or burst her down

party_model._about: A typical party arriving on floor 4. Levels reset each expedition (#172); level adds 2 health. Accuracy is aim + dexterity as companion.gd computes it.
